NonlinearHistoryAcceptance.description:
Acceptance of the members over the records (``fem.acceptance``). Method
``fibreStrain``: each fibre's peak strain at the member's end sections against a share of
the strain at which its material fails. P5: method ``hingeRotation``: the hinges of the
pack's ``pushover.hinges`` (``fem.hinges``) at the member ends, their peak deformation over
each record against the limit of ``performanceLevel``.

deformationShare.description: A member's deformation may reach at most this × the deformation at which it fails (fibreStrain).
deformationShare.title: Deformationshare

residualStrengthShare.description: Strength (share of the peak) below which the component has failed (fibreStrain).
residualStrengthShare.title: Residualstrengthshare

gravityLossAllMembers.description: The smaller of the gravity-loss and the strength-loss deformation for every member (false: the gravity loss only for members carrying gravity loads).
gravityLossAllMembers.title: Gravitylossallmembers

reinforcementFractureStrain.description: Strain at which a reinforcing bar is taken as lost (fracture or buckling; fibreStrain).
reinforcementFractureStrain.title: Reinforcementfracturestrain

steelFractureStrain.description: Strain at which a structural steel fibre is taken as lost (fibreStrain).
steelFractureStrain.title: Steelfracturestrain

performanceLevel.description: hingeRotation: the level of ``pushover.hinges.levels`` the hinges are checked against (empty: the last, the most lenient).
performanceLevel.title: Performancelevel

note.description: Why the values are what they are.
note.title: Note

NonlinearHistoryAcceptance.title: NonlinearHistoryAcceptance

NonlinearHistoryDamping.description:
P5: the damping of the nonlinear time histories, by method id: ``mode1Stiffness`` (the
ratio on the first mode, in proportion to the committed stiffness) or ``rayleigh`` (mass and
committed stiffness proportional, the ratio at the first mode's period and at
``secondPeriodShare`` times it).

ratio.description: Damping ratio (empty: each time history's own).
ratio.title: Ratio

secondPeriodShare.description: rayleigh: the second period as a share of the first.
secondPeriodShare.title: Secondperiodshare

NonlinearHistoryDamping.title: NonlinearHistoryDamping

NonlinearHistoryDrift.description:
The storey drift of the nonlinear time histories against the allowable drift of the
linear procedures (the pack's ``seismic`` drift table, with its redundancy rule).

limitFactor.description: The drift may reach this × the allowable storey drift of the linear procedures.
limitFactor.title: Limitfactor

amplify.description: Whether the drifts are multiplied by Cd/I (false: the nonlinear drifts are the real ones).
amplify.title: Amplify

note.description: Why the values are what they are.
note.title: Note

NonlinearHistoryDrift.title: NonlinearHistoryDrift

NonlinearHistoryForceAction.description:
P5: a force-controlled action of the members checked over the records: ``action``
(``columnAxial``: the compression of the columns, ``shear``: the shear of the beams and
columns), its class and the factor on its earthquake part, γ·(Fu − Fg) + Fg ≤ the design
strength of the member design (Fu the design value over the suite, Fg the force under
gravity alone).

category.description: The code's class of the action (e.g. critical).
category.title: Category

factor.description: γ on the earthquake part of the demand.
factor.title: Factor

NonlinearHistoryForceAction.title: NonlinearHistoryForceAction

NonlinearHistoryForceControlled.description:
P5: force-controlled actions (``actions``), the importance factor on their earthquake part
when ``importance``, and how the strength is read (``strength``: the member design's design
strength, the safe side of an expected strength).
NonlinearHistoryForceControlled.title: NonlinearHistoryForceControlled

NonlinearHistoryProcedure.description: How the nonlinear time histories are run and read (``fem.nonlinear_history``).

target.description: The ``seismic.timeHistory.targets`` entry the records are scaled to (its R and I; the period range, ratios and least number of records of that table apply).
target.title: Target

meanFrom.description: From this many records (or pairs) the design value is the mean of their peak responses, with fewer the largest.
meanFrom.title: Meanfrom

scaleToStaticShear.description: Whether the responses are scaled up to the equivalent static base shear (the nonlinear results are used as they come when false).
scaleToStaticShear.title: Scaletostaticshear

pDelta.description: P-Delta effects in the columns and walls.
pDelta.title: Pdelta

designReview.description: The code asks for an independent design review.
designReview.title: Designreview

unacceptableResponses.description: P5: by occupancy (risk) category, how many records of a suite may stop early (an unacceptable response) and the suite still be accepted (absent: none).
unacceptableResponses.title: Unacceptableresponses

damping.description: P5: the damping of the runs (empty: the first-mode, committed-stiffness ratio of each time history).

note.description: Why the values are what they are.
note.title: Note

NonlinearHistoryProcedure.title: NonlinearHistoryProcedure

description:
Nonlinear time history analysis: the procedure, the drift limit and the acceptance of
the members.

source.description: Clause (and page) the table comes from.
source.title: Source

sources.description: Clause references of single entries: {key: clause}.
sources.title: Sources

clauses.description: Short clause references the results cite, by key, without the code's name (e.g. 'Part 6 Sec 2.5.7.3'); read by saengine.codes.context.cite. A key the pack does not give is not cited.
clauses.title: Clauses
